title: SYNTHETIC AIS practice-improvement roadmap — preparation example
assumptions: All groups, findings, service facts, timings and outcomes in this collection are fictional; none are University findings.
Day zero is a hypothetical planning origin, not a booked kickoff or a calendar date.
A phase is a requested start horizon: [0,90), [90,180), [180,infinity). Work may finish in a later phase.
Elapsed duration is not staff effort. Parallel dependency layers are not evidence of available capacity.
Recommendations and priorities require professional review. This planner does not compute maturity or select products.

recommendations.title: Establish service and evidence ownership
recommendations.practice_change: Move from informal ownership to a maintained service-to-role register, without inferring a maturity rating.
recommendations.observable_outcome: Three fictional service records have named accountable roles, supporting artifacts and a review date.
assumptions: Elapsed days include interviews and review; staffing availability has not been confirmed.

recommendations.title: Pilot requirements-to-test review
recommendations.practice_change: Make sampled changes traceable from acceptance criteria to executed verification.
recommendations.observable_outcome: For the next six fictional changes, record coverage and unresolved acceptance criteria; do not count document completion as improved quality.
assumptions: Pilot is limited to one release stream; existing delivery work continues.

recommendations.title: Rehearse release recovery and verification
recommendations.practice_change: Turn a written recovery procedure into a rehearsed, evidence-backed practice.
recommendations.observable_outcome: One synthetic rehearsal records decision points, recovery elapsed time, business checks and follow-up actions.
assumptions: No production rollback is performed; the practice rehearsal uses fictional records.

recommendations.title: Clarify service-identity lifecycle roles
recommendations.practice_change: Attach lifecycle responsibility and successor roles to documented service identities.
recommendations.observable_outcome: Each fictional identity has an owner, purpose, renewal/retirement decision and continuity dependency.
assumptions: This models documentation work only; it does not change access or credentials.

recommendations.title: Run a security-event review pilot
recommendations.practice_change: Connect selected operational evidence to review ownership and documented follow-through.
recommendations.observable_outcome: Two synthetic review cycles show selected events, dispositions, escalation rationale and actions still open.
assumptions: Review time is an elapsed-duration estimate; actual recurring staff effort remains to collect.

recommendations.title: Adopt and compare the two practice pilots
recommendations.practice_change: Extend demonstrated practices only after reviewing each pilot and preserving cross-group differences.
recommendations.observable_outcome: Compare baseline and follow-up using equivalent windows; retain disagreements and reject unsupported improvement claims.
assumptions: Dependency-only earliest-start bounds assume suitable staff can work after the pilot reviews.

recommendations.title: Evaluate sustained practice and revise the roadmap
recommendations.practice_change: Review whether practices remain used and produce the intended outcomes before proposing another maturity step.
recommendations.observable_outcome: Retain sustained-use evidence, outcome trends, counterexamples and a revised prioritization rationale.
assumptions: A one-to-two-level progression is a proposed assessment goal, not a predicted score or guaranteed result.

recommendations.title: Measure the AI workflow baseline
recommendations.practice_change: Replace an assumed productivity benefit with a comparable baseline measurement design.
recommendations.observable_outcome: Identify comparable tasks, repair effort, outcome criteria and a collection owner before estimating a pilot.
assumptions: Duration and ownership are deliberately unknown; no productivity multiplier is assumed.

recommendations.title: Evaluate an AI-assisted documentation pilot
recommendations.practice_change: Compare a bounded assisted workflow with its measured baseline using the same acceptance criteria.
recommendations.observable_outcome: Report accepted outputs, checking and rework time, unresolved cases and recurring maintenance separately.
assumptions: The pilot cannot receive start/finish estimates until R08 is estimated; no model service is called.

recommendations.title: Map an external-interface transition
recommendations.practice_change: Turn an uncertain external change window into an explicit dependency and evidence collection plan.
recommendations.observable_outcome: Document the interface version, owner, transition window and compatibility evidence needed for a rehearsal.
assumptions: The 80–110 day range is wholly synthetic and intentionally crosses the phase boundary.

recommendations.title: Rehearse the mapped interface transition
recommendations.practice_change: Test the documented transition after the dependency mapping is available.
recommendations.observable_outcome: A fictional compatibility rehearsal records failures, mitigations and pending external inputs.
assumptions: The requested first-phase start is at risk; the predecessor may not finish until day 110.

recommendations.title: Close transition follow-up and capture the outcome
recommendations.practice_change: Use rehearsal results to choose follow-up work rather than asserting completion from a planned date.
recommendations.observable_outcome: Link each mitigation to a verification record and explain changed or unresolved actions.
assumptions: The first-phase request is demonstrably infeasible even at the optimistic bound; it is not silently rephased.
